item.text: The notes distinguish three senses of “trustworthy”: faithful delivery, a reputation already known to his people, and one possible sense of being entrusted with the community. They also address Noah’s commission, the emphasis in “إِنِّى,” and how his claim supports his appeal. I’ll keep those questions separate.
